panel.name: Client-Pitch Decision Committee
panel.objective: Determine whether a client-side decision committee would vote to award this studio's pitch, and identify the specific objections that would be raised in the room the studio is not in.
panel.decision_signal: A committee member would vote to award, or would actively advocate for awarding, this scope to this studio.
panel.signer_note: Everyone whose no stops the deal, filled in during setup-committee step 3b. A list, never one name - co-owners and partners routinely both have to say yes. Every name here gets its own seat, marked "signer": true in that seat's entry.
panel.review_due: Set a date to re-check these composites against real pitch outcomes.
panel.calibration_outcome: The real award decision, plus the objections actually raised by the real committee.
panel.calibration_horizon: Whenever the client responds to the pitch, with a check at the first follow-up call.

seats.name: Dana Whitcomb
seats.decision_signal: Would vote to award and would personally carry the recommendation to the CEO.

seats.name: Priya Raghunathan
seats.decision_signal: Would endorse the work as consistent with the brand system rather than objecting to it in the debrief.

seats.name: Marcus Deng
seats.decision_signal: Would clear the commercial terms for signature without sending the proposal back for restructuring.

seats.name: Tobias Lindqvist
seats.decision_signal: Would push the committee toward this studio because the work is braver than the alternatives.

seats.name: Alicia Brandt
seats.decision_signal: Applies a substantiation gate: PASS if no claim in the pitch requires proof the client cannot produce, FLAG otherwise.

seats.name: Rhonda Feliciano
seats.decision_signal: Would vote to award despite having been burned before, because this pitch names how it will be different.

seats.name: Kevin Oyelaran
seats.decision_signal: Would support the award because the work has a credible path to the numbers he is measured on.

seats.name: Sofia Marchetti
seats.decision_signal: Would volunteer to own this day to day, which is what makes an award survive the first quarter.

seats.name: Gerald Nyquist
seats.decision_signal: Would release the budget line for this rather than holding it against a competing request.

seats.name: Nadia Osei
seats.decision_signal: Would tell the committee this is safe to put in market rather than flagging external risk.

seats.name: Doug Prentiss
seats.decision_signal: Would stop defending the incumbent agency in this specific scope.

seats.name: Hollis Beaumont
seats.decision_signal: Enthusiasm without authority. A YES here is a warning that the pitch is winning a room that cannot buy.

seats.name: Ellery Kwan
seats.decision_signal: Fixed principled non-converter. A YES here means the pitch overpromised or the seat drifted out of character.
